recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the accepted FHIR-49818 source change without disturbing the previously-added qualification-code search parameter, the composite search parameter, or unrelated Practitioner search parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-49818 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by PA. It requested a way to search Practitioner by qualification.code and resolved to remove standalone qualification-period as a search parameter, replacing it with a composite search parameter consisting of qualification-code and qualification-period.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged source commit 0211b763fc46d6330ba6329d3f7798f5cd6fe903 added Practitioner-qualification-code and Practitioner-qual-code-period to source/practitioner/bundle-Practitioner-search-params.xml, but left the older standalone Practitioner-qualification-period entry in place. The combined branch did not already have an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-49818 before this work.
additional_context: Practitioner is active in source/fhir.ini. The standalone qualification-period parameter was introduced by FHIR-20206/32a98da21abd66b3d95e6e91499ca1c467ddd944 for R5, but FHIR-49818 is the later Applied R6 decision that supersedes standalone use by keeping period only as part of the qualification code/period composite. PA Confluence minutes showed the disposition/vote trail and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Removed only the standalone Practitioner-qualification-period SearchParameter entry from the active Practitioner search-parameter bundle. The qualification-code token parameter and qual-code-period composite remain, including the composite qualification-period component needed to express the accepted code-plus-period search.
